## Improvements and fixes
- Home presents recent documents, projects and workspaces in separate tabs alongside persistent favorites. - Larger Leonardo lettering sits behind the Home content without reserving a top band, and the background adapts to smaller windows. - Recent projects and workspaces no longer appear twice when the same folder is opened through different URL forms. Existing duplicate history is cleaned on load while preserving order and favorite stars.
## Distribution
Stable release for Apple silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized, retaining the existing Sparkle update key.
Promotes beta 0.1.404, validated by the owner with confirmation that duplicate entries are resolved. The functional code and dependencies are unchanged; a new higher build is used for stable updates. General updater channel-matrix acceptance remains tracked separately in issues #15 and #84.

## Fixed
- Prevent duplicate recent project and workspace entries when the same folder is opened through URL forms with or without a trailing slash. - Remove existing duplicate history when preferences are loaded, while preserving recency order and favorite stars.
## Distribution
Signed and notarized macOS arm64 beta. Select Beta in Preferences → Updates to subscribe. This prerelease does not replace the stable channel.
Hosted update/install/relaunch acceptance remains pending; publication alone does not assert it passed.
